historyDuration.title: {duration, select, hour {uma hora} day {24 horas} week {uma semana} month {4 semanas} other {Todos}}
historyDuration.note: Description of what period of history data should be deleted.

summaryClearTabsHistoryDuration.title: {openTabs, plural, one {Fechar {openTabs} separador e eliminar {durationDesc} de histórico de navegação e cookies?} other {Fechar {openTabs} separadores e eliminar {durationDesc} de histórico de navegação e cookies?}}
summaryClearTabsHistoryDuration.note: Description of data to be removed after the user submits the form. Placeholders stand for: 1. the number of tabs that will be affected; 2. the timespan of data to be removed (translated separately with key historyDuration). Example: Close 3 tabs and delete 2 weeks of browsing…

summaryClearTabsDuration.title: {openTabs, plural, one {Fechar {openTabs} separador e eliminar {durationDesc} de cookies?} other {Close {openTabs} separadores e eliminar {durationDesc} de cookies?}}
summaryClearTabsDuration.note: Description of data to be removed after the user submits the form. Placeholders stand for: 1. the number of tabs that will be affected; 2. the timespan of data to be removed (translated separately with key historyDuration). Example: Close 3 tabs and delete 2 weeks of cookies?

summaryClearHistoryDuration.title: Apagar {durationDesc} de histórico de navegação e cookies?
summaryClearHistoryDuration.note: Description of data to be removed after the user submits the form. The placeholder stands for the timespan of data to be removed (translated separately with key historyDuration). Example: Delete 2 weeks of browsing…

summaryClearCookiesDuration.title: Eliminar {durationDesc} de cookies?
summaryClearCookiesDuration.note: Description of data to be removed after the user submits the form. The placeholder stands for the timespan of data to be removed (translated separately with key historyDuration). Example: Delete 2 weeks of cookies?

summaryClearTabsHistoryAll.title: Fechar {openTabs} {openTabs, plural, =1 {separador} other {separadores}}, e limpar todo o histórico de navegação e cookies ({cookies} {cookies, plural, =1 {site} other {sites}})?
summaryClearTabsHistoryAll.note: Description of data to be removed after the user submits the form. The placeholders are for the number of tabs to be closed, and the number of sites where we'll delete cookies. Example: Close 3 tabs, and delete browsing history and cookies (2 sites)?

summaryClearTabsAll.title: Fechar {openTabs} {openTabs, plural, =1 {separador} other {separadores}} e eliminar todos os cookies ({cookies} {cookies, plural, =1 {site} other {sites}})?
summaryClearTabsAll.note: Description of data to be removed after the user submits the form. The placeholders are for the number of tabs to be closed, and the number of sites where we'll delete cookies. Example: Close 3 tabs, and delete all cookies (2 sites)?

summaryClearHistoryAll.title: {cookies, plural, one {Apagar todo o histórico de navegação e cookies ({cookies} site)?} other {Apagar todo o histórico de navegação e cookies ({cookies} sites)?}}
summaryClearHistoryAll.note: Description of data to be removed after the user submits the form. The placeholders stand for the number of sites where we'll delete cookies. Example: Delete all browsing history and cookies (2 sites)?

summaryClearCookiesAll.title: {cookies, plural, one {Apagar todos os cookies ({cookies} site)?} other {Apagar todos os cookies ({cookies} sites)?}}
summaryClearCookiesAll.note: Description of data to be removed after the user submits the form. The placeholders stand for the number of sites where we'll delete cookies. Example: Delete all cookies (2 sites)?

summaryClearTabsHistorySite.note: Description of data to be removed after the user submits the form. Example: "Close 3 example.com tabs, and delete all example.com cookies?".

summaryClearTabsSite.title: {openTabs, plural, one {Fecha {openTabs} separador de {site} e elimina todos os cookies de {site}?} other {Fechar {openTabs} separadores em {site} e eliminar todos os cookies de {site}?}}
summaryClearTabsSite.note: Description of data to be removed after the user submits the form. Example: "Close 3 example.com tabs, and delete all example.com cookies?".

summaryClearHistorySite.title: Apagar todo o histórico de navegação e cookies de {site}?
summaryClearHistorySite.note: Description of data to be removed after the user submits the form. Example: Delete all example.com browsing history and cookies?

summaryClearCookiesSite.title: Apagar todos os cookies de {site}?
summaryClearCookiesSite.note: Description of data to be removed after the user submits the form. Delete all example.com cookies?

summaryPinnedIgnored.title: {tabs, plural, one {{tabs} separador afixado será ignorado.} other {{tabs} separadores afixados serão ignorados.}}
summaryPinnedIgnored.note: Notice to tell the user that some tabs will not be closed. Example: 3 pinned tabs will be ignored.

clearData.title: Eliminar
clearData.note: Button text to start data deletion.

cancel.title: Cancelar
cancel.note: Button text to exit the fire button modal.

clearingCookiesWarning.title: Isto irá repor as tuas definições de pesquisa.
clearingCookiesWarning.note: Warning message shown when deleting cookies, informing the user that their search settings will be reset.

learnMore.title: Saiba mais
learnMore.note: Link text that opens a help page with more information about deleting cookies and search settings.

historyAndDownloadsNotAffected.title: Para também apagar o histórico, selecione um intervalo de tempo.
historyAndDownloadsNotAffected.note: Notice to tell the user that the chosen deletion settings will not affect history and downloads because a time period has not been selected from the dropdown.
